description.text: Objective: Through study, students could learn Tai Ji, Mantis Boxing, Gave Mulan Boxing, and Sanda of Wushu etc. Besides wushu learning, students could also grasp basic Chinese communication ability and lay the foundation for further learning Chinese traditional wushu essence and Chinese traditional culture. Characteristic: Taught in Chinese and English Courses: Chinese Pronunciation, Chinsese Vocabulary, Chinese Grammar, Chinese Reading, Chinese Writing, Chinese Listening, Oral Chinese, Tai Ji, Mantis Boxing, Gave Mulan Boxing, and Sanda of Wushu etc. Notes: The program will open if the number of applicants are over 10 or above. It could accept group and individual registration. Group class could decide the study content and study time.

duration.text: The Chinese Traditional Martial Arts Program at Ludong University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1388 USD/per semester ￥ 10000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate of HSK If applicable. Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test), No need for English medium programs

requirements.text: 1.(Applicants must be) non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2.(Applicants must) Be in good health 3.(Applicants should be between the) age of 16 to 45
